changes.old_value: Ideas do not simply coexist — they clash, transform, and generate new ideas through their very opposition. Every significant intellectual work contains tensions it cannot fully resolve, contradictions it may not even recognize, and dependencies on the very positions it claims to oppose. changes.new_value: A one-page account of the central tension and its handling: both owned and scoped positions, what can or cannot coexist, the warranted transition, what is preserved, and the remainder. Desks lift relations, transitions and remainders. An adequate distinction or continuing mediation is a positive finding; no forced progress. One text with developed positions or a sequence of supplied texts; include all sides of any claimed contradiction.
